network_commands.command: echo "=== non-slash to= values ==="; grep -rhoE 'to="[^"]*"' src/ | sort -u | grep -v 'to="/' | head -40; echo "=== mailto/http ==="; grep -rn 'mailto\|http://\|https://' src/ | head; echo "=== MorePages head ==="; sed -n '1,40p' src/pages/MorePages.tsx

for p in / /about /academics /life-at-michigan /athletics /research /health-medicine /initiatives /giving /prospective-students /current-students /faculty-staff /parents /alumni /schools-colleges /facts-figures /contact /search /about/privacy /_404.html; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:4173$p"); echo "$code $p"; done

cd /workspace/recreation/output && python3 -m http.server 5173 > /tmp/out.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/index.html
